text.en: OSTrack is row 120 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Detection Segmentation area.
text.zh: OSTrack 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 120 行，所属领域为“检测与分割”。

text.en: The annual table associates OSTrack with “Joint feature learning and relation modeling for tracking: A one-stream framework”.
text.zh: 年度表把 OSTrack 与论文《Joint feature learning and relation modeling for tracking: A one-stream framework》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Botao Ye, Xilin Chen”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Botao Ye（官方页拼写）、Xilin Chen（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Botao Ye, Xilin Chen”。
